mcpServers.name: Employee Onboarding Talent Pool MCP
mcpServers.description: Deterministic read-only facade over the Talent Pool employee directory for the Employee Onboarding network. Enriches an incoming employee record with a postal address matched from the employee's email when the address is missing. Tools only — no resources, no prompts, no LLM reasoning. Mock for the Employee Onboarding Agent Network v2 PoC.

tools.name: match_email_to_address
tools.description: Looks up an employee's postal address from the Talent Pool directory by email. Used to enrich a new-hire record when the address was not provided.

email.description: The employee's work email to match against the Talent Pool directory.

tools.name: lookup_employee_department
tools.description: Looks up an employee's department and cost center from the Talent Pool directory by email. Provided by the Talent Pool directory but not used by the onboarding broker graph.

email.description: The employee's work email to match against the Talent Pool directory.

agentCards.name: Employee Onboarding Badging Agent
agentCards.description: Initiates and tracks the employee badging process for the Employee Onboarding network, including outreach for badge photo collection. Initiates a badge request from employeeId and email, returning a badge request ID. Mock agent for the Employee Onboarding Agent Network v2 PoC.

skills.name: initiate_badge_request
skills.description: Initiates a badge request for a new employee, including outreach for badge photo collection, from a plain-text request containing the employee ID and email. Example: "Initiate a badge request for Employee ID EMP1001, email alex.smith@example.com." Returns a badge request ID with status photo_requested.

agentCards.name: Employee Onboarding Workday Agent

skills.name: create_new_hire
skills.description: Creates a new employee record in Workday from a plain-text request containing name, email, phone, and address. Example: "Create a new hire in Workday. Name: Jane Doe. Email: jane.doe@example.com. Phone: 9876543210. Address: 123 Main St, Mumbai." Returns the created record with a Workday Employee ID. If the address is missing, responds input-required asking for it.
